caption: The drawing depicts a piece of wooden furniture, likely a secretary desk or cabinet, rendered in shades of reddish-brown and outlined in darker lines. The composition includes a frontal view and a right-side profile view of the object. The frontal view reveals two sections: the upper section features two arched, paneled doors (the left door is open, showing inner shelving with decorative cutouts) and internal shelves, while the lower section contains a drop-down writing surface and compartments inside for organization. Below the writing surface are drawers arranged with two smaller upper drawers and three larger ones below, each with metal handles colored in a dull gold or brass tone. The cabinet stands on four rounded feet, spherical in shape. The side profile on the right shows the furniture's overall depth and the contours of the arched top, as well as the step-back shape above the drawers. The drawing sits within a double-lined rectangular border on a cream background.
title: Block Front Desk with Cabinet Top
